propositions: The close path grants disposition-closed bugs (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated) an exemption and withholds completion-verifier attestation, but the certification path requires valid completion-verifier attestations on every closed child with no disposition branch, creating a certifiable state with no non-force exit

A disposition-closed child with a live replacement link cannot earn the required attestation because reopening and re-closing takes the same exemption branch every time, producing identical results on every attempt

The fix provides a disposition-verifier attestation for linked duplicates with deterministic signing (no LLM call), allowing certification to forward through the replacement link while preserving the constraint that the signature does not claim a completion PASS
The force-close guard must run before the disposition branch to prevent --force-close from becoming a way to certify without verifying
Three exempt classes (duplicate, not_a_bug, escalated) now share one definition of disposition with live replacement via the class set and _has_live_replacement_link predicate
